description: List users in a course with optional Canvas filters. Use `include` to request email, enrollments, avatar_url, bio, and other fields otherwise omitted from the default response. Use `enrollment_type` / `enrollment_state` to narrow by role or status, `search_term` to filter by name/login, `user_ids` to fetch a specific subset, and `sort`/`order` to control ordering.

enrollment_state.description: Filter by enrollment state (e.g. active, invited)

enrollment_type.description: Filter by one or more enrollment types

include.description: Extra fields to include on each user (Canvas include[] param)

search_term.description: Partial name or full login/SIS ID to filter users by

user_ids.description: Restrict the result to the given user IDs

name: list_course_users
title: List Course Users
